nodes.description: Formed with am/is/are/was/were + past participle (V3) when the receiver of action is emphasized.
Mini-questions added to the end of a statement for confirmation or agreement.

nodes.title_fa: جملات مرکب با حروف ربط هماهنگ‌کننده
nodes.description: Connecting two independent clauses using comma + coordinating conjunction.

nodes.description: Core vocabulary including respect, elderly, nursing home, forgive, devotion, burst into tears.

nodes.description: Writing clear paragraphs with a controlling idea in the topic sentence followed by supporting details.

nodes.title_fa: ساختار مجهول با افعال معین (can, must, should)
nodes.description: Formed with modal + be + past participle (e.g., must be protected, can be seen).
Using who for persons, which for objects, and that for both to combine sentences.

nodes.title_fa: جملات شرطی نوع دوم (فرضی و غیرواقعی)
nodes.description: If + simple past, would/could + base verb for hypothetical present/future situations.
Vocabulary such as dictionary, definition, entry, symbol, arrange, look up, bilingual, collocation.

nodes.title_fa: مجهول در تمام زمان‌ها (از جمله گذشته کامل)
nodes.description: Formed with had been + past participle or will be + past participle in environmental contexts.
Key concepts: solar energy, wind turbine, electricity, pollution, fossil fuel, replace, generate.
Summarizing main points or restating the topic sentence with concluding transition words.

edges.notes: Past simple regular and irregular verb forms are required to build past passive.
Past participle morphology (V3) introduced in Grade 11 is needed for passive voice.
Auxiliary verbs and modals are inverted in the tag.
Basic passive concept must be understood before applying to modals.
Contrasts real present conditions with unreal hypothetical conditions.
Past perfect establishes a time sequence relative to simple past.
Active past perfect must precede passive past perfect.

l1_patterns.error_title_fa: حذف فعل کمکی to be در ساختار مجهول
l1_patterns.incorrect_pattern_en: The bridge built two hundred years ago.
l1_patterns.correct_pattern_en: The bridge was built two hundred years ago.
l1_patterns.l1_root_cause_fa: در فارسی عبارت 'پل دویست سال پیش ساخته شد' فعل کمکی مجزای بودن ندارد.
l1_patterns.remedial_drill_template: Insert the correct form of 'be' (is/are/was/were) in: [stem]

l1_patterns.error_title_fa: اشتباه در علامت مثبت و منفی (قطبیت) تگ سوالی
l1_patterns.incorrect_pattern_en: Ali is a student, is he?
l1_patterns.correct_pattern_en: Ali is a student, isn't he?
l1_patterns.l1_root_cause_fa: در زبان فارسی از عبارت ثابت 'مگه نه؟' یا 'درسته؟' بدون تغییر فعل استفاده می‌شود.
l1_patterns.remedial_drill_template: Complete the tag question with opposite polarity for: [stem]

l1_patterns.error_title_fa: تکرار ضمیر مفعولی اضافی در جمله‌واره موصولی
l1_patterns.incorrect_pattern_en: This is the book which I read it yesterday.
l1_patterns.correct_pattern_en: This is the book which I read yesterday.
l1_patterns.l1_root_cause_fa: در فارسی ضمیر متصل مفعولی در جمله پایه تکرار می‌شود (کتابی که دیروز آن را خواندم).
l1_patterns.remedial_drill_template: Delete the redundant object pronoun in: [stem]

l1_patterns.error_title_fa: استفاده از زمان حال یا will در شرطی نوع دوم
l1_patterns.incorrect_pattern_en: If I have more money, I would buy that car.
l1_patterns.correct_pattern_en: If I had more money, I would buy that car.
l1_patterns.l1_root_cause_fa: ترجمه فارسی هر دو نوع شرطی گاهی با فعل مضارع التزامی بیان می‌شود.
